$comment: Known SDK/contract shape disagreements, enumerated so NEW ones fail.
Not a count. A stored number drifts from the truth in silence and this repo
has already shipped one that sat unchanged through two rounds of work; a list
fails loudly when a new disagreement appears, and shrinking it is a visible
diff naming exactly what was fixed.
Each entry is Type.property. Being here does NOT mean the SDK is wrong — the
gate reports disagreement and cannot tell which side is stale. WebhookEvent
is the worked example: the SDK says occurred_at, the contract requires
created_at, and the gateway really does send occurred_at, so there the SPEC
is the one to fix. Check the handler before editing either side.
